name: Long Haul
description: The three burgers down a corridor the full width of the screen: everything an ingredient needs at one end, everything a dish needs at the other, a tray rack halfway. Built for the tray, with small crates and a delivery door for the 86 system.
strategy: Fetch the tray early and bring three ingredients per trip; leave it by the boards and let the plates travel in hands. When a crate empties, unload the delivery at the far end on the next ingredient run.
